Forty-Three Row Controls

H6 — the buttons inside the rows take .icon-action-btn, in four local vocabularies replaced by one.

The colour is the message. Before, the same three verbs were drawn in five different Bootstrap colours across these pages — green View, amber Edit, red Delete on Passports; grey outline Edit on Household Members; a flat pill on the three inline-edit pages. After, Edit is one blue, Delete one red, View one teal, everywhere.

Cash Receipts is here because the suite found it. Holding .icon-delete to one picture turned up a button titled “Void this receipt” wearing Delete’s name and drawing fa-ban. Voiding keeps the record, so the class was claiming something the button does not do. It takes .icon-void — Danger’s colour, its own name.

base gains three names and no new colours — .icon-save on --alv-good, .icon-cancel on the resting ink, and .icon-void on danger. That is base’s own rule for a new action, the one .icon-upload was added under.

Icons are missing here, not on the site. Font Awesome is not loaded in this fixture, so an icon-only button shows as its own outline — which is exactly what makes the colour and the 34×34 shape legible in these shots.

Rendered from the backup (before) and from the changed file (after), same stylesheet, at 1280 px and 390 px.
